# Which cargo audit findings does your Rust code actually use?

> Paste cargo audit --json and your Rust source: see which flagged crates your code actually uses and which are test-only or unreferenced noise. Free cargo audit triage, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/cargo-audit-triage/)
- [How to triage cargo audit findings without ignoring real risk](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/cargo-audit-triage/how-to-triage-cargo-audit-findings.html)
